It appears as amorphous/laminated eosinophilic material, more consistent with keratinized debris or hyalinized stroma rather than identifiable fetal squamous cells.

Since the witness confidence (0.70) is not in the low range (<0.40) and it explicitly contradicts the external text, protocol dictates I trust the visual evidence of *this* image instance.

**No.** The photomicrographs do not show a field packed with laminated swirls of fetal squamous cells.
